step_content.title: Command delegates to the pipeline
step_content.body: Thin command, fat pipeline. The command only resolves the flow id and picks **render options**.

step_content.title: Three composable stages
step_content.body:
Each stage takes the context and returns it enriched:

- `loadAggregate` reads the flow from SQLite
- `renderMarkdownBody` turns it into text
- `maybeApplyFrontmatter` prepends the JSON blob

step_content.title: Where a new format plugs in
step_content.body:
A note-only step: no file behind it.

1. Add a sibling renderer next to `generateFlowMarkdown`
2. Pick it in the render stage
3. Leave the aggregate query alone
